instruction: Please help me configure VS Code to automatically save files after a 500 millisecond delay when I make changes.

metadata.explanation: Task requires the agent to modify VS Code settings.json to enable auto-save with afterDelay mode and set the delay to 500ms. The evaluator uses the existing check_json_settings function to verify both settings are present with correct values.
metadata.verification: The check_json_settings function verifies that settings.json contains 'files.autoSave': 'afterDelay' and 'files.autoSaveDelay': 500. No new functions needed as this uses the existing vscode.check_json_settings metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete instruction coverage: Evaluator checks both required settings (files.autoSave='afterDelay' and files.autoSaveDelay=500)
Correct getter logic: vm_file getter fetches the standard VS Code settings file from /home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json
Correct metric logic: check_json_settings properly handles type='rule' by accessing expected['expected'] and verifies all key-value pairs match exactly
Semantically correct expected values: Both settings match VS Code documentation requirements for auto-save after delay
No postconfig needed: settings.json is a persistent file that doesn't require any UI state to be maintained
Proper parameter handling: Metric function correctly extracts the rules dict without the common error pattern of accessing expected.get('rules')

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json_settings first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
metric check_json_settings second parameter type (str) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)
